'''Astelle al'Seen''' is a [[Two Rivers]] resident.

== Appearance ==
She is white-haired and bent-backed.

== Activities ==
She is among the people at [[Jac al'Seen]]'s farm when [[Perrin Aybara]] visits there. She pokes him with her walking stick when she sees his yellow eyes, as if he might not be real and seems shocked to get a response.{{ref/book|4|32}}
